message.text:
The markdown.Service interface has one concrete implementation: the unexported `service` struct in internal/markdown/markdown.go. It is constructed by markdown.NewService().

NewAPIV1Service constructs the single markdown.NewService instance and passes it to RSSService via server.go. RebuildMemoPayload in memo_service.go receives markdown.Service directly from APIV1Service. APIV1Service holds the interface in its MarkdownService field. MarkdownRenderer is a separate internal type used by the service but does not implement the Service interface.

RSSService holds the interface in its MarkdownService field. memopayload.Runner also holds it in its MarkdownService field, though it may not be constructed in production. RebuildMemoPayload receives the interface as a function parameter rather than storing it in a persistent field. MarkdownRenderer executes at runtime inside service methods but does not implement the Service interface.

`*renderer.MarkdownRenderer` is constructed inline via `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` and used inside service methods. `memopayload.Runner` is never wired in production server startup.

Only one implementation of `markdown.Service` exists: the unexported `service` struct.

`APIV1Service` constructs the `service` instance and holds it. `RSSService` receives the same instance via constructor injection from `server.go`. `memopayload.Runner` declares the field type but is never instantiated; only `RebuildMemoPayload` accepts `markdown.Service` as a parameter.

The concrete implementation is `*markdown.service`, created by `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` inside `NewArvice`. `*renderer.MarkdownRenderer` may handle AST-to-markdown sub-operations.
